literal: The false conduct of him who has a deceitful mind, the five elements within indeed will laugh.
translation: At the false conduct of a man with a deceitful mind, the five elements that dwell within him will laugh in derision.
modern: வஞ்சக மனதை உடையவனுடைய பொய்யான ஒழுக்கத்தைக் கண்டு, அவனுடைய உடம்பிற்குள் இருக்கும் ஐந்து பூதங்களும் மனதிற்குள் சிரிக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet exposes the futility of hypocrisy. A person may successfully deceive the outside world with a false show of virtuous conduct (படிற்றொழுக்கம்). However, they cannot hide their true nature from the five elements (பூதங்கள் ஐந்தும்)—earth, water, fire, air, and space—that constitute their own physical body. Knowing the inner deceit, these elements laugh inwardly (அகத்தே நகும்) at the hypocrite's pretense, emphasizing that true virtue must be genuine and internal.
